name: aphrody
description: Pure-Rust single-MCP-server automation surface for Claude Code. ONE native binary `aphrody-mcp` (~7 MB, sub-millisecond cold-start) exposes 23 tools across 6 capability groups — 8 ex-google_mcp (coding_style_guide, universal_web_fetch, dns_recon, auth_extract, chrome_autopsy, advanced_recon, native_hooks, start_dashboard) + 7 ex-bxc-mcp (bxc_scrape, bxc_recon, bxc_detect, google_search, google_atlas_route, extract_structured, vision_analyze) + 2 voice (voice_synthesize, voice_transcribe) + 2 Context7 (context7_resolve_library_id, context7_query_docs, native Rust port of the upstream Bun bridge) + 3 Microsoft Learn (microsoft_docs_search, microsoft_docs_fetch, microsoft_code_sample_search — native Rust HTTP MCP proxy onto learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp) + 1 re_triage (PE/ELF binary triage via aphrody-re). Zero JS runtime, zero subprocess relay, zero secondary MCP server. 4 slash commands (/scrape, /tokens, /status, /docs). 28 agents, 41 skills. Cross-platform: Linux #1, Windows #2, WASM #3.

interface.shortDescription: One Rust binary, 23 tools: desktop automation, scraping, vision, voice, Context7 docs, Microsoft Learn docs.
